title: fix(bus): dispatch refuses a head with no delivery row
body:
<!-- ccr-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"tvofi"} -->
A pull request's own row, `dev/programme/delivery/<N>.md`, is the orchestrator's
and lands before the review (`delivery-status-tracking.md`; `handoff_push.sh`
writes it at open). When it lands *after* the merge verdict, the row commit
moves the head off the one the reviewer measured, and `app_approve.sh --carry`
refuses a commit of the branch's own, so the only recovery is a fresh review --
a whole reviewer round for a one-line record file. This is class E of
`dev/audit/rca/R9-RCA-1990.md`, which refused the other candidate, widening
`--carry` to accept a row-only commit, as widening a governance instrument's
acceptance at about 2 in 57 merges. This change removes the cause instead:
`tools/audit/seat/bus.sh dispatch` now refuses a head whose tree carries no
`dev/programme/delivery/<pr>.md`. A verdict posts only against a dispatch's
nonce (`push-verdict`, `dispatched_to`), so dispatch is the single chokepoint,
and gating it keeps the row from landing late.

## Head

`3fe438baab892cc4ced53da0f007677607175eb7` merges main `93ab6ffa` into the
previous head. One conflicted file, `tools/audit/seat/bus.sh`, resolved
preserving both sides: main's #2115 nonce binding (push-verdict refuses a nonce
unbound to its dispatch's head; the re-issued fresh-dispatch arm `N1c`) and
this branch's no-delivery-row dispatch refusal with its `norow` fixtures and
null control, unchanged. The single textual conflict was the `self_test`
locals declaration; the resolution is the union (`norow` from this branch,
`N1c` from main), dropping `rs`, whose only use was the pre-#2115 form of the
"round 1's nonce does not count at another head" arm that main's nonce-binding
rewrite supersedes — main's form of that arm survives and is green. The
self-test passes with the union of arms: `58 checks, 0 failed`.

`659e992e6ba2dd4d9db9f4a941508ffbdd4f114e` merges main `382ec8b` into the previous head: an automatic merge by the orchestrator, no resolution.

`dc9defda271fa6ba024a710aad86f1b3b97363df` merges main `595c23b57` into the
previous head. One conflicted file, `tools/audit/seat/bus.sh`, resolved
preserving both sides: main's `orphans`/`content_superseded` command, header
paragraph and self-test arms (224 added lines), and this branch's dispatch row
gate with its real-head test fixtures, unchanged.

`4095d5c89c01b9f124149d56e4f38bd87911002a` merges main `664a4c0` into the previous head: an automatic merge by the orchestrator, no resolution. The reviewed code is unchanged.

`326db6d566f3def0239c396918b3184c6bb9b66e` merges main `d5f5841` into the previous head: an automatic merge by the orchestrator, no resolution. The reviewed code is unchanged.

`61642464a5f148092e691830d021fa524e7e3ae7` merges main `d214c53` into the previous head: an automatic merge by the orchestrator, no resolution. The reviewed code is unchanged.

`bd9dd83e36a6601f99ab6e3a4f8c3f531eeb3247` merges main `d3dbf2c` into the previous head: an automatic merge by the orchestrator, no resolution. The reviewed code is unchanged.

`da2b6345011354ef7ec5b30b1cd57da2d95dbb83` adds one commit to the previous head, containing only this PR's own row, `dev/programme/delivery/2107.md`. The authored code head is `8961643da111cc7612e1f2c097321171075fdc43`.

`8961643da111cc7612e1f2c097321171075fdc43`

## Mutation proof

Re-derived at this head `3fe438baa`.

Forcing the row predicate true (`git cat-file -e "$h:$row"` -> `true`) turns the
arm red; restoring it turns it green:

    $ bash tools/audit/seat/bus.sh --self-test   # row predicate forced true
      FAIL dispatch refuses a head with no delivery row (the ordering, #1990 class E)
    bus self-test: 58 checks, 1 failed
    $ bash tools/audit/seat/bus.sh --self-test   # restored
    bus self-test: 58 checks, 0 failed

The arm was written first and fails on the pre-fix tree for the same reason,
so it pins the defect it names.

## Null control

Re-derived at this head `3fe438baa` against `origin/main`'s `93ab6ffa` (a
detached worktree; its `bus.sh` carries no row refusal — `grep -c 'carries no
$row'` is 0).

The unmodified tree dispatches the rowless head; this branch refuses the very
same dispatch:

    $ (cd WT@origin/main && HPO_BUS_STATE=$(mktemp -d) \
        bash tools/audit/seat/bus.sh dispatch 2075 addd6f45758ff90ab862bcbe62357c1373ed7786 cmsg)
    bus-nonce: f2685ef8b26200296883042e36dbb280   (rc 0)
    $ HPO_BUS_STATE=$(mktemp -d) bash tools/audit/seat/bus.sh dispatch 2075 addd6f45758ff90ab862bcbe62357c1373ed7786 cmsg
    bus: REFUSE: dispatch: #2075's head addd6f45758ff90ab862bcbe62357c1373ed7786 carries no dev/programme/delivery/2075.md; the row lands before the review (delivery-status-tracking.md) -- write it and re-push, then dispatch   (rc 1)

## Figures

Re-derived at this head `3fe438baa`.

- The row's position against the merge verdict, newest 60 pull requests:
  `python3 tools/audit/seat/row_position.py --limit 60` -- 23
  `row-before-verdict`, 15 `no-merge-verdict`, 2 `row-AFTER-verdict` (#2151
  merged, #2148 closed), 20 `no-row-in-head`, rc 0.
- The gate and its null control on the real head, #2075: re-derived at this
  head, quoted under Null control above.
- The self-test count: `bash tools/audit/seat/bus.sh --self-test` --
  `58 checks, 0 failed` at this head (the union of arms, all green); the
  pre-fix baseline was `45 checks, 0 failed`.

## Red checks

`closures-autofix` — red once in this branch's history from the same family the recarry consumed: the pre-#2164 composed-verify stdout leak era's downstream artifact failure (the lane's repair never ran because the recording it consumes never landed — "Artifact not found: closure-recordings") and the stale-table failures before #2173 landed. Not caused by this diff; the cheaper detector is the lane itself, which re-fires on every push and names a real closure defect.

`closures` — red in this head's history from the same stale-table family (the lane-balance pole `boost_drift_replay.py` recorded 3379.1 s > half the table since the 282054566 re-record, and the ci-budget row `archscore.coord_footprint` grown 2587->2592 by #2118 without re-recording), both fixed on main by #2173 and #2175 before this head's recarry. Not caused by this diff; the cheaper detector for each is the check that went red (the closure selftest pin, the entities null control) — no additional standing detector is warranted.

`fast (3.14)` — red in this head's history from the same two main-data defects, neither caused by this diff: the closures lane-balance pole fixed by #2173's optimality arm and honest re-record, and the ci-budget row fixed by #2175's deliberate re-record. Both landed before this head's recarry; the cheaper detector for each is the check that went red. No additional standing detector is warranted.

`harness header EXPECTED vs RESULT (#817)` was red in the authoring seat's
environment (`12 of 109 HARNESS HEADER CHECKS FAILED`): `python3 -c 'import
sys;sys.path.insert(0,"tests");import harness_headers as h;
print(h._discover())'` executes 9 harnesses, all under `dev/audit/rounds/`,
none of which this diff touches, and `dirty_registers()` returns `(True,
'clean')`; its inputs are byte-identical to main's, so its result is main's.
The scoped gate runs no script for this diff and CI is the authority.

`arch-score` and `env-matrix` — red in this branch's history (22:1x-22:4xZ window) on the GitHub App installation's exhausted hourly API quota (HTTP 403 inside the jobs before any scoring/matrix ran): infra failures, not defects of this diff; both checks re-fire on every pull_request event and have run green in this window elsewhere. The cheaper detector is each check itself.

`validate-hacs` — red in this branch's history during the 22:1x-22:4xZ window when the GitHub App installation's hourly API quota was exhausted (HTTP 403 in the job): an infra failure, not a defect of this diff; the check re-fires on every pull_request event and validates the integration manifest identically each time.
## Forward-carry

The ordering is stated in `tools/audit/seat/bus.sh`'s header, where the
orchestrator running `dispatch` reads it. It is not added to
`dev/governance/rules/delivery-status-tracking.md`: that file is policy and
code-owned, so the line is the owner's to approve.

## Friction

delivery-status-tracking: unenforced: the row must land before the review, but
nothing refused a head without one; a row added after the verdict moves the head
off the measured one and costs a re-review (R9-RCA-1990 class E; #2075 open,
#2072 a row-only extra round).
